A user-supplied clip carries no intrinsics and no ground-plane calibration,
and a monocular-depth network is a second model on a CPU-only node. The
bbox-bottom alternative needs camera height and pitch — more unknowns, not
fewer.

What the gate needs is a monotonic, consistently biased range over the
occluder, which this delivers. When the estimate disagrees with the scenario
the two camera constants are retuned — never the admission gate." style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#f2f4f9;strokeColor=#e3e6f0;fontColor=#3d3d46;fontSize=13.2;fontStyle=0;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;align=left;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="286" width="560" height="192" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="b26" value="Why the frames are paced

Each sampled frame is held until a computed deadline on the monotonic clock,
so clip time and run time are the same second. The deadline is computed rather
than accumulated: a fixed sleep per frame folds the inference cost into
scenario time and drifts without bound over a run.

Without pacing no instant in the demo choreography is expressible, which is
why it is load-bearing rather than a preference." svg.text: The detector — one pipeline behind a frame-source seam
Phase 3 replaced the recorded fixture with real perception. Nothing above the seam knows where a frame came from.
an image layer, not a stream
one R3 JSONL line per detection, carrying
a stable own:n id from the association
A user-supplied clip carries no intrinsics and no ground-plane calibration,
and a monocular-depth network is a second model on a CPU-only node. The
bbox-bottom alternative needs camera height and pitch — more unknowns, not
What the gate needs is a monotonic, consistently biased range over the
occluder, which this delivers. When the estimate disagrees with the scenario
the two camera constants are retuned — never the admission gate.
Each sampled frame is held until a computed deadline on the monotonic clock,
so clip time and run time are the same second. The deadline is computed rather
than accumulated: a fixed sleep per frame folds the inference cost into
scenario time and drifts without bound over a run.
Without pacing no instant in the demo choreography is expressible, which is
why it is load-bearing rather than a preference.
